authors.name: Sourcing Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team evaluates supplier capabilities and RFQ structures to ensure matched leads meet engineering specifications.

editorial.how_we_test: We verify manufacturer IPC/WHMA-A-620 certifications and review their production capabilities before matching them with RFQs.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We operate a pay-per-lead model where harness manufacturers pay to access verified RFQs from engineers and procurement staff. We do not charge the buyers submitting RFQs.
editorial.corrections: If a manufacturer's certification status changes or capabilities are misrepresented, we remove them from the matching pool immediately and update our records. Email corrections to compliance@aiwireharness.com.
